description: This file defines an abstract C++ class 'AmbxWrapper' within the 'c_wrappers' namespace. The class declares several pure virtual functions for handling operations related to 'amxb' bus context, such as loading, connecting, registering, reading, obtaining file descriptor, freeing resources, and removing all instances. It also includes relevant header files from the 'amxc', 'amxp', 'amxd', and 'amxb' modules, indicating its role in wrapping or interfacing with these components.
